package.description: A standalone set of shared libraries that enables the execution of compiled MATLAB, Simulink applications, or components

en-US.description: A standalone set of shared libraries that enables the execution of compiled MATLAB, Simulink applications, or components
en-US.longDescription: The MATLAB Runtime is a standalone set of shared libraries that enables the execution of compiled MATLAB, Simulink applications, or components. When used together, MATLAB, MATLAB Compiler, Simulink Compiler, and the MATLAB Runtime enable you to create and distribute numerical applications, simulations, or software components quickly and securely.
en-US.name: MATLAB Runtime

zh-CN.description: 一组用于运行已编译的 MATLAB、Simulink 应用程序或组件独立的共享库
zh-CN.longDescription: MATLAB Runtime 是一个独立的共享库集合，用于运行编译后的 MATLAB 和 Simulink 应用程序或组件。当 MATLAB、MATLAB Compiler、Simulink Compiler 与 MATLAB Runtime 配合使用时，您可以快速且安全地创建并分发数值计算应用程序、仿真模型或软件组件。
